plan.notes: MERGE NOTE: this is the OLDER-catalog (2023-2024, Faculty Senate UPMCB No. 5, effective 8-23) BS CS schedule; a newer-catalog 2026-2027 plan (id wsupullman-bs-computer-science) also exists. Prereqs naming an either/or choice slot's individual options (e.g. 'CPT S 121'/'CPT S 131') were repointed at the choice slot's own code ('CPT S 121/131') per pipeline rule; verbatim catalog wording kept in each prereq's raw field. Source: official Washington State University Faculty Senate 'Undergraduate and Professional Major Change Bulletin (UPMCB) No. 5, Fall 2022', item 'Revise graduation requirements for BS in Computer Science', Faculty-Senate-approved 11-17-22, effective 8-23 (2023-2024 catalog year). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official PDF at the source_url above. No later Faculty Senate revision to the BS in Computer Science was found (checked bulletins through 2026-09-30; later UMCB items touch other EECS programs, e.g. Cybersecurity). Program: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Pullman), Voiland College of Engineering and Architecture; 120 credits. TRANSCRIPTION METHOD: the bulletin shows changes as underlined (new) / crossed-out (old) text; this plan encodes the new (underlined) schedule effective 8-23. Old text excluded: PHYS 201/211 and 202/212 lines in Year 2, 'Biological Sciences with Lab [BSCI]' in Year 4 Term 2, CPT S 427 in Year 3 Term 2 (moved into the Technical Electives list), and the Technical Elective in Year 3 Term 1. Credit-range choices: MATH 220/225 and MATH 273/301 are '2 or 3' in the bulletin; this plan uses the 2-credit options (MATH 220, MATH 273) so the plan sums to exactly 120 = total_credits; choosing MATH 225 and/or MATH 301 raises the degree total to 121-122. Bulletin footnotes transcribed in full in the relevant choice_notes: (1) C/C++ path (121, 122, 223, 360) vs Java path (131, 132, 233, 370), stay on one path; Java path not offered in Tri-Cities. (2) Lab Science: 8 cr total, one [BSCI] and one [PSCI] course with lab, from CHEM 105/106, PHYSICS 201+211, 202+212, BIOLOGY 106/107. (3) CPT S Technical Electives: 4 courses / 12 cr, at least one Software and at least one Data/Information Management course. (4) Computer Science Electives: 5 courses / 15 cr, at least 9 cr in CPT S. (5) ECONS 101/102 recommended for the SSCI slot. UCORE: per the bulletin, students must complete 6 of the 7 UCORE designations (ARTS, BSCI, DIVR, EQJS, HUM, PSCI, SSCI); this schedule pins ARTS, DIVR, SSCI, HUM plus BSCI/PSCI via the lab-science slots. Course titles verified 2026-09-30 against official WSU sources: CPT_S titles from catalog.wsu.edu course pages; MATH 171/172/216/220/225/273/301 from the WSU catalog MATH course list; STAT 360 'Probability and Statistics' from Faculty Senate curriculum bulletins; HISTORY 105 'Roots of Contemporary Issues' from ucore.wsu.edu; ENGLISH 101 'College Composition' from WSU Core-to-Career/UCORE listings; CHEM 105/106 and PHYSICS 201/211/202/212 titles from cas.wsu.edu and the WSU College of Education chemistry endorsement checksheet; BIOLOGY 106/107 from cas.wsu.edu. Two titles carry documented conflicts between official WSU sources: ENGLISH 402 is 'Technical Writing' on mme.wsu.edu and the official Tri-Cities advising worksheet but 'Technical and Professional Writing' on the WICHE Interstate Passport table for WSU; PHIL 201 is 'Introduction to Formal Logic' on online.wsu.edu, the WICHE passport table, and third-party transfer-equivalency data, but 'Elementary Logic' on the cas.wsu.edu Philosophy degree-plan page (this plan uses the majority/official-registrar form, flagged honestly). Prereqs were verified against the catalog CPT_S, MATH, and STAT course pages; catalog 'C or better' grade rules are preserved in the one_of raw text. Note: ~/workspace/degree-tracker/seed/plans/wsupullman-bs-computer-science.json already holds a newer-catalog (2026-2027, effective 8-26) BS CS plan for WSU Pullman with the same school; this file is the older-catalog (2023-2024) schedule, so its plan id is distinct: wsupullman-bs-computer-science-2023-2024.
